GitHub Hosting, Local Assets & Google Drive Auto-Save

🚀 1. All Your `Interactive Book` Assets Are Integrated!

This file embeds your 6 Park Backgrounds, 8 Headless Child Body Templates, 7 Parent Look-After Scenes, and 21 Pairwise Fight Illustrations directly inside the HTML, and automatically loads your Play Together (`play-*`), Say Sorry (`sorry-*`), Arguing (`kids-*-vs-*`), and Friends Song MP3s from your Google Drive or relative GitHub folders (`Kids-play-together-21 (1)/`, `Kids-say-sorry-21/`, `kids arguing/`, `Friends Song (1).mp3`).

Active: Embedded WebP + Google Drive / GitHub Smart Loader

☁️ 2. Direct PDF Save to Your Google Drive

Paste your Google Apps Script Web App URL below so students' completed PDFs upload straight to your Google Drive folder automatically on Page 12:

📋 Click to copy the Google Apps Script (takes 30 seconds to deploy in your Drive) 
function doPost(e) {
  var data = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents);
  var folders = DriveApp.getFoldersByName("Interactive Book");
  var folder = folders.hasNext() ? folders.next() : DriveApp.getRootFolder();
  var bytes = Utilities.base64Decode(data.pdfBase64);
  var blob = Utilities.newBlob(bytes, "application/pdf", data.filename || "Storybook.pdf");
  var file = folder.createFile(blob);
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ status: "ok", url: file.getUrl() }))
    .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}
